correctness.rationale: Work in truncated free noncommutative Q-algebra and map each word w to ∏(1+X_letter). Coefficients exactly count scattered subsequences up to degree r. The difference between μ^j(0), μ^j(1) has first nonzero homogeneous degree j+1; induction uses the commutator with X0+X1 and a nonzero coefficient. Every proper prefix offset d=2^v e with odd e separates the two source-letter block profiles in degree v+1≤r, since complementary length-e prefixes have unequal zero counts. For nonaligned adjacent windows the profiles are H_a^−1 Q^M H_b and H_b^−1 Q^M H_c, and unipotent constant-one conjugation cannot invert a nontrivial E since the first nonzero homogeneous component changes sign. Hence equality iff a=b=c, while aligned windows always agree. Independently checked 7,728 arbitrary-source cases across r=1..3, source sizes 3..6, all available multiplier/offsets using direct scattered-subsequence profile counts. The proof rather than finite tests applies to every source and M. Dyadic Thue–Morse phase corollary is already covered by prior fixed-point work and is NOT asserted original.
